units.source_text: 这一席话，又重新把我们拉回到初次见面时的同一位置上。

en.t: These words once again brought us back to the same position we had been in when we first met.
He had regained his own position.

units.source_text: 因此我也能轻松地探问有关那位住在西班牙式洋房的小姐的情况。

en.t: Because of that, I could also ask quite easily about the young lady who lived in the Spanish-style Western house.
